title: Plot

fields.name: file
fields.description: Set filename to store the records.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Specify the key name from the record to extract as the value.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of [workers](/manual/administration/multithreading.md#outputs) to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex

description: The Plot output plugin generates data files in a format compatible with GNU Plot (gnuplot), a command-line graphing tool.
